title: Ginsenoside Rh4 activates AMPK and alleviates NFkappaB-mediated inflammation in hyperlipidemic hepatopathy.
authors: Zhang, Jiawei; Wang, Chenxue; Liu, Xuyun; Jing, Zhicheng; Cao, Ke; Liu, Jiankang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究人参皂苷Rh4通过分子对接激活AMPK并缓解NFκB介导的炎症，虽涉及分子对接但对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK) regulates lipid metabolism and mitochondrial function in hepatocytes and plays a critical role in liver diseases including hyperlipidemic hepatopathy. Thus, targeting AMPK may represent a potential avenue for treating hyperlipidemic hepatopathy. Herein, we employed molecular docking to screen nine common ginsenosides and identified ginsenoside Rh4 (Rh4) as a potent AMPK activator. While Rh4 is known for its anticancer properties, its effects on hyperlipidemic hepatopathy have not been explored. We subsequently evaluated its efficacy and underlying mechanisms using a poloxamer 407-induced mouse model and a palmitic acid-treated HepG2 cell model. We found that Rh4 significantly improved hyperlipidemic hepatopathy both in vivo and in vitro by upregulating AMPK phosphorylation, preventing mitochondrial dysfunction, reducing lipid accumulation, and attenuating oxidative stress, along with alleviating nuclear factor kappa-B (NFkappaB)-mediated inflammation. More importantly, Rh4 stabilized the AMPK-NFkappaB complex in the cytoplasm by binding to AMPK, thereby disrupting NFkappaB nuclear translocation and suppressing the transcription of pro-inflammatory genes. An AMPK inhibitor markedly diminished the benefits of Rh4 on these pathways. These findings suggest that Rh4 may serve as a promising therapeutic agent for hyperlipidemic hepatopathy by activating AMPK.
abstract_zh: AMP活化蛋白激酶（AMPK）调节肝细胞中的脂质代谢和线粒体功能，并在包括高脂血症性肝病在内的肝脏疾病中发挥关键作用。因此，靶向AMPK可能代表治疗高脂血症性肝病的一种潜在途径。在此，我们采用分子对接筛选了九种常见的人参皂苷，并鉴定出人参皂苷Rh4（Rh4）作为一种有效的AMPK激活剂。尽管Rh4以其抗癌特性而闻名，但其对高脂血症性肝病的作用尚未被探索。我们随后使用泊洛沙姆407诱导的小鼠模型和棕榈酸处理的HepG2细胞模型评估了其疗效和潜在机制。我们发现，Rh4通过上调AMPK磷酸化、防止线粒体功能障碍、减少脂质积累和减轻氧化应激，以及缓解核因子kappa-B（NFkappaB）介导的炎症，在体内和体外均显著改善了高脂血症性肝病。更重要的是，Rh4通过与AMPK结合稳定细胞质中的AMPK-NFkappaB复合物，从而阻断NFkappaB核转位并抑制促炎基因的转录。AMPK抑制剂显著削弱了Rh4对这些通路的益处。这些发现表明，Rh4可能通过激活AMPK成为治疗高脂血症性肝病的一种有前景的治疗药物。
